title: Ancient DNA Rewrites Story of Early Migration
summary: Genomes from a cave site point to an earlier crossing.

body.text: Officials stressed that the plan will be rolled out gradually to avoid disruption.
Further details are expected at a briefing scheduled for later this month.
We are only at the beginning of what this makes possible.
Early reactions from the community have been broadly positive, though some raised questions about timing.
Critics argue the numbers are promising but still need to be confirmed at larger scale.

author.name: Omar Hassan
author.bio: Science correspondent covering energy and climate.
